  function bit
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_agent_configuration::decode_prop_val
 (  string prop_name , bit [1023:0] prop_val , ref string prop_val_string , input svt_pattern_data :: type_enum typ  ) 

Simple utility used to convert 'bit [1023:0]' property value representation into its equivalent string property value representation. Extended to support decoding of enum values.

prop_name - Name of the property being encoded.

prop_val_string - String describing the value to be encoded.

prop_val - Bit vector encoding of prop_val_string.

typ - Optional field type used to help in the encode effort.

Return values - Status indicating the success/failure of the decode.

Member Attribute Documentation

 bit  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_agent_configuration::dsi_chk_enable = 1'b1

Enable/Disable DPHY/PPI protocol checks.
  • 1: Enabled: All the protocol violations would be reported.
  • 0: Disabled: No protocol violation would be reported.
  • This will enable or disable the checks for each instance of DSI.
  • The default value of this variable is 1’b1.

 bit  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_agent_configuration::dsi_chk_fail_cov_enable = 1'b0

Enable/Disable DPHY/PPI protocol check FAIL coverage
  • 1: Enabled: Protocol check FAIL coverage is enabled.
  • 0: Disabled: Protocol check FAIL coverage is disabled.
  • This will enable or disable the coverage for each instance of DSI.
  • The default value of this variable is 1’b0.

 bit  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_agent_configuration::dsi_chk_pass_cov_enable = 1'b0

  • 1: Enabled: Protocol check PASS coverage is enabled.
  • 0: Disabled: Protocol check PASS coverage is disabled.
  • This will enable or disable the coverage for each instance of DSI.
  • The default value of this variable is 1’b0.

 bit  attribute
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_agent_configuration::dsi_cov_enable = 1'b0

Enable/Disable all functional coverage of DSI monitor including D-PHY/PPI coverage ,
  • 1: Functional coverage of DSI monitor is enabled.
  • 0: Functional coverage of DSI monitor is disabled.
  • This will enable or disable the coverage for each instance of DSI.
  • The default value of this variable is 1’b0.

 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_agent_configuration::dsi_dual_monitor_enable = 1'b1

Enable/Disable Dual DSI monitor.
  • 1: Dual DSI monitor is enabled.
  • 0: Dual DSI monitor is disabled.
  • This variable value is only considered when monitor_enable is set to 1.
